content:
Last week saw notable discounts on several current Apple products, ranging from 25% off the AirPods Pro 3 to $120 off the latest AirPods Max 2, with deals coming thick and fast. While those offers are still live, Amazon has just set an all-time low price on the AirTag 2, which Apple launched in 2026, at just $20 each.

During last week's anniversary sales, we reported several record-low prices on the AirTag 2. If you missed out, don't worry—the price has now dropped even further, making this the best deal we've seen since the site launched.

Amazon still has the single AirTag 2 available for as low as $24, matching the lowest price we've seen since launch. The 4-pack has been reduced to $79.99 with free shipping.

Apple's official 4-pack is priced at $99, which is already better value than the usual $29 per single unit. Now selling at nearly 20% off, this is an all-time low, working out at just $20 per AirTag 2 on average.

While the previous $90 deal on the 4-pack will almost certainly remain available at various retailers during their anniversary sales, Amazon's all-time low is a different story—there's no telling when the price might suddenly jump back up.

We've previously compared the original AirTag with this year's AirTag 2—check out that article if you're interested. Here's a recap of the key points:

  • Precision finding range is 1.5 times further than the previous generation
  • Volume is up to 50% louder than the previous generation
  • The AirTag 2's sound can be heard from twice the distance
  • Adds 'a series of industry-first anti-stalking safeguards'

Upcoming features for the AirTag 2

The AirTag 2 dropping to $20 each comes just ahead of next month's launch of iOS 27 and watchOS 27. For Apple Watch users, there's more good news: the Find My app is gaining Precision Finding support. This means you can now use on-screen arrows and distance indicators on your Apple Watch to locate your AirTag.

watchOS 27 will also unify the Find My experience within a single app. Previously, the Apple Watch Find My experience was split across three separate app icons—'People', 'Items', and 'Devices'—arranged in the app list or pages.

Meanwhile, iOS 27 brings a brand-new design and interface improvements to the Find My app, making it easier to track people and items.

With all this in mind, now is the perfect time to expand your AirTag 2 collection—especially at this price point.

More top Apple deals this week:

  • AirPods Max 2 — $429 (original price $549)
  • AirPods Pro 3 — $190 (original price $249)
  • AirPods 4 — $99 (original price $129)
